title: Riemannian Flow Matching for Brain Connectivity Matrices via Pullback Geometry
tldr_zh: 全局微分同胚 pullback 度量下，黎曼 CFM 等价于变换后欧氏 CFM；SPD 用矩阵对数、相关矩阵用归一化 Cholesky，训练快 8 倍采样快 10 倍
tldr_en: Pullback metrics from global diffeomorphisms make Riemannian CFM equivalent to Euclidean CFM after transformation; 8x faster training, 10x faster sampling on SPD/correlation matrices

key_numbers.number: 8x faster training, 10x faster sampling vs RIEMCFM
4600+ fMRI scans from 2800 subjects; 30000+ EEG trials from 26 subjects

relations.type: 继承并简化（Riemannian CFM 的 pullback 特例）
同属流形生成线，本文避免热核计算
竞争（欧氏训练+后处理投影 vs 微分同胚保约束）
